# Money

> Money is a trusted financial news and advice platform providing expert guidance on credit, insurance, loans, and personal finance since 1972.

Money.com delivers comprehensive financial education and tools across credit management, insurance comparison, loan navigation, and investment guidance. The site serves as a resource for consumers seeking to build credit, manage debt, and make informed financial decisions.

## Core Finance Sections

- [Money – Finance News & Advice Since 1972](https://money.com): Money's homepage offering finance news, advice, and tools for financial success.
- [Credit](https://money.com/credit): Expert guidance on credit building, repair, and identity theft protection.
- [Insurance](https://money.com/insurance): Insurance comparison and guidance for car, home, and life insurance coverage.
- [Loans](https://money.com/loans): Comprehensive loan guides covering student, personal, auto, and mortgage options.
